node.statement: XR PREDICATE P-B (low-core spread heart — the anti-concentration heart). At each of the six clean-rate candidates, for every globally generic-branch pair (u,v), the number of post-strip live slopes with all pairwise cores <= k-1 (singletons included) is <= 8n^3, dihedral-symmetric and extension-type slopes counted inside. Row pins (audit-recomputed): the six clean-rate candidates = (RowC n=1024, prize n=2^41) x rates 1/4, 1/8, 1/16; A = k + n/scale + 1 with deciding scales 256/256/512; B* = floor((2^1279)^(1/10)) at prize (log2 = 127.9000); q idealized (2^250 prime-unpinned, 2^255.9) with the I2 q = p^k pin caveat (0.089-bit sliver) inherited; extension-type mass INSIDE predicate scope. FM-witnessing caveat: all Face-3 evidence sits at FM = Theta(1)..107; candidate-row behavior is extrapolation. K2 Face-3 axis-Q instance (chain step 5e) — cite BOTH rigidity_kernel AND rk_rigidity_kernel (catch #35). PROVED AROUND IT: validity is automatic in the globally generic branch; the strip ledger and consumption arithmetic are exact (three independent implementations agree: 52/52, 50/50, 69/69). The all-LineRay affine-core theorem pays the slope target whenever one one-per-slope selector has affine error rank sigma<=3. The affine-core cogirth ray bound strengthens the full-domain paid selector ranks to 4,4,3,11,11,10 on the six rows, so a counterexample has minimum selector rank at least 5,5,4,12,12,11 respectively. SUP-FORM PIN: per-pair sup quantifier, forced by the consumer's 'for every pair' — toy evidence is mean/median-flavored, so evidence strength != predicate strength (declared). ATTACK SURFACE: f2_effective_energy_dichotomy (portable verbatim per its statement), SCK adjacency, E27 spectrum.
